project_title: PandaCare Live KPI & Executive Command Center Platform
industry: Healthcare / Home Health Care / Executive Operations
text:
PandaCare Live KPI Reporting Platform & Executive Command Center:
Designed and engineered a live management command center for PandaCare to give leadership instant visibility (<10 seconds) into Lead Volume, Source Performance, Marketing Spend Efficiency, CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost), Pipeline Conversion Velocity, Employee Performance, and Client Lifecycle/Retention.
Directly mapped to PandaCare's live GoHighLevel operations in Michigan.

project_title: PandaCare Live KPI & Executive Command Center Platform
text:
PandaCare GoHighLevel 11-Stage Pipeline Data Architecture:
The entire reporting system was engineered around PandaCare's exact GoHighLevel pipeline:
1. Unassigned Lead
2. Vetting Lead
3. MCD Applicant
4. Pending HH App. Forms
5. Dr. Appt. Scheduled
6. Referred to the County
7. ASW Assigned, Pending CA
8. CA Scheduled
9. CA Completed, Pending Auth
10. Auth Received, Pending PA
11. Provided Clock-in Information
Final Outcomes: Client / Closed (Won) | Disqualified (Non-Qualified / Failed Lead).
Includes SLA timers, bottleneck stage alerts, and conversion velocity tracking across all 11 stages.

project_title: PandaCare Live KPI & Executive Command Center Platform
topic: Marketing Attribution, Source Performance & CAC Engine
text:
Multi-Channel Lead Attribution & Marketing Efficiency Engine (PandaCare):
Aggregated and correlated lead sources (Facebook Ads, Google PPC, Direct Inquiries, Community Referrals) with actual ad spend to compute real-time Cost Per Lead (CPL), Cost Per Qualified Applicant (CPQA), and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).
Enabled management to identify top-performing ad channels and terminate underperforming campaigns dynamically.

project_title: PandaCare Live KPI & Executive Command Center Platform
text:
Employee Performance Leaderboard & Rep Accountability (PandaCare):
Tracks individual team member KPIs including Speed to Lead (first contact time), stage conversion ratios, overdue task backlog, and client onboarding success rate.
Provides automated warnings when leads remain in vetting or county referral stages past defined SLA thresholds.

project_title: XortLogix Facebook Ads Analytics & Client Management Dashboard
text:
XortLogix Facebook Ads Analytics & Client Management Platform:
Architected a custom white-label analytics dashboard providing near real-time reporting directly from Meta/Facebook Marketing APIs without relying on expensive 3rd-party reporting intermediaries.
Tech Stack: Laravel backend (PHP), Bootstrap frontend, Meta Marketing API (Insights, Campaigns, Ad Sets, Ads), and GoHighLevel (GHL) API v2 with Webhook integrations.
Hosted entirely on the client's custom domain with full data ownership.

project_title: XortLogix Facebook Ads Analytics & Client Management Dashboard
text:
Multi-Tenant Agency Client & Ad Account Switcher:
Built a scalable multi-company structure enabling agency managers to switch between clients and ad accounts seamlessly via dynamic dropdown filters.
Supports side-by-side performance comparison across accounts (Impressions, Clicks, CTR, CPC, Spend, ROAS, and Lead Conversion counts).

project_title: XortLogix Facebook Ads Analytics & Client Management Dashboard
text:
GoHighLevel (GHL) Workflow Triggering & Multi-Format Reporting Exports:
Integrated bi-directional synchronization with GoHighLevel to trigger automated CRM workflows and follow-up sequences directly from dashboard performance events.
Includes automated scheduled report generation and on-demand exports in Excel, CSV, and branded PDF formats.
